title: K-injective preservation for constant scalar restriction
statement: For the completed-to-constant coefficient map on a scheme W, restriction on strict towers preserves K-injective complexes.

proof.text: Restriction is right adjoint to finite-free completed scalar extension. Exactness of the extension and whiskering the adjunction over the tower index give the K-injective preservation criterion.

source.place: Finite-free dual-basis exactness and K-injective adjunction criterion
